title: From rides to startups: the entrepreneurial impact of ride-hailing platforms
title_zh: 从出行到创业：网约车平台的创业影响
title_primary: 从出行到创业：网约车平台的创业影响
title_secondary: From rides to startups: the entrepreneurial impact of ride-hailing platforms
authors: Guanfu Fang, Xiaoyu Hu, Haoran Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the impact of ride-hailing platforms on entrepreneurship by exploiting the staggered rollout of Didi, China’s dominant ride-hailing service, across cities. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that platform entry increases per capita new business registrations. Mechanism analyses show that improved consumption convenience and expanded market access are the primary drivers, whereas income smoothing and failure protection play little role. These findings highlight substantial economic spillovers from digital platforms beyond their immediate markets and underscore the potential of digital infrastructure investments to foster entrepreneurship in developing economies. We thank the editor and anonymous referees for their valuable comments and suggestions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过利用滴滴——中国占主导地位的网约车服务——在各城市交错推出的特点，考察网约车平台对创业的影响。采用双重差分设计，我们发现平台进入提高了人均新企业注册量。机制分析表明，消费便利性的改善和市场准入的扩大是主要驱动因素，而收入平滑和失败保护的作用甚微。这些发现凸显了数字平台在其直接市场之外产生的显著经济溢出效应，并强调了数字基础设施投资在发展中经济体促进创业的潜力。关键词：发展中经济体 创业 市场扩张 网约车平台 JEL分类：L26 R41 L86 致谢 我们感谢戴延科、左翔和徐扬飞提出的建设性建议。我们感谢编辑和匿名审稿人提出的宝贵意见和建议。

title: Legal pluralism and coastal land access: Inequalities, governance, and tourism pressure in Mahajanga
title_zh: 法律多元主义与沿海土地获取：马哈赞加的不平等、治理与旅游压力
title_primary: 法律多元主义与沿海土地获取：马哈赞加的不平等、治理与旅游压力
title_secondary: Legal pluralism and coastal land access: Inequalities, governance, and tourism pressure in Mahajanga
authors: Lucien Ramiandrisoa
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article examines unequal access to coastal land in Mahajanga, Madagascar, under legal pluralism and growing tourism pressure. It analyses the gap between state land law, customary tenure practices and effective control over coastal space. The study uses a mixed-methods single-case design. Primary data come from 300 participants: 180 completed structured questionnaires and 120 took part in semi-structured interviews. Additional primary evidence includes observations across 16 sites, georeferenced records, field photographs and 100 locally collected taratasy, or informal land deeds. Secondary data include 47 land registration files, legal texts, cadastral records, census data and satellite imagery. Formal tenure security rarely matches widespread customary occupation. Among the 200 local household and resident participants, 72.0% relied mainly on customary arrangements, while only 15.0% held a registered land title. Coastal sectors with greater tourism development also show higher land values, a stronger concentration of formal transactions near the shoreline and more conflicts over access, enclosure and territorial control. Formal registration remains easier for actors with greater financial resources and stronger administrative networks. Within the Amborovy coastal sector, particularly in Marohala, Petite Plage and Grand Pavois, fences and tourism facilities restrict public access to the shore and reduce spaces used by fishing households. Existing land management tools therefore give limited protection to long-established occupants during rapid market change. The findings support closer coordination between land administration, local land uses and public coastal access. The case extends debates on legal pluralism and tourism-led land restructuring to secondary coastal cities in the Global South.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了马达加斯加马哈赞加在法律多元主义和旅游业日益增长的压力下，沿海土地获取的不平等现象。文章分析了国家土地法、习惯保有制度与沿海空间实际控制之间的差距。研究采用混合方法的单案例设计。一手数据来自300名参与者：180人完成了结构化问卷，120人参与了半结构化访谈。其他一手证据包括16个地点的观察记录、地理参照数据、实地照片以及100份当地收集的非正式土地契约（taratasy）。二手数据包括47份土地登记档案、法律文本、地籍记录、人口普查数据和卫星影像。正式保有权的保障程度很少能与普遍的习惯占有相匹配。在200名当地家庭和居民参与者中，72.0%主要依赖习惯安排，而仅有15.0%持有注册土地所有权。旅游业发展程度较高的沿海区域也显示出更高的土地价值、更集中的近岸正式交易，以及更多关于通行权、圈占和领土控制的冲突。正式登记对于拥有更多财政资源和更强行政网络的行动者而言更为容易。在安博罗维沿海区域，特别是在马罗哈拉、小海滩和大帕瓦瓦，围栏和旅游设施限制了公众进入海岸的通道，并减少了渔业家庭使用的空间。因此，现有的土地管理工具在市场快速变化时期对长期定居者的保护十分有限。研究结果支持土地管理、地方土地利用和公共沿海通行权之间更紧密的协调。该案例将法律多元主义和旅游导向的土地重组的讨论扩展至全球南方的次级沿海城市。

title: Variations in the two-step norm elicitation procedure: timing, incentives, and scope
title_zh: 两步规范引出程序中的变化：时机、激励与范围
title_primary: 两步规范引出程序中的变化：时机、激励与范围
title_secondary: Variations in the two-step norm elicitation procedure: timing, incentives, and scope
authors: Sabrina Plaß
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The two-step norm elicitation procedure (opinion-matching) is widely used to measure personal normative beliefs and incentivized normative expectations, yet little is known about how sensitive it is to common design variations. This study tests the robustness of the procedure by examining whether personal normative beliefs, normative expectations, and behaviour change when elements of the elicitation procedure are varied. Using an online dictator game with a four-point scale, the baseline treatment asks participants to evaluate the appropriateness of a fair allocation. Two treatments manipulate (i) the timing of elicitation (before vs. after the decision) and (ii) incentives for normative expectations, while (iii) a third treatment varies the scope by asking participants to evaluate two action subsets (fair and low-share allocations). Timing does not significantly affect behaviour, personal normative beliefs, or normative expectations, whereas incentivizing normative expectations improves the accuracy with which participants correctly identify the modal personal normative belief. Evaluating two action subsets does not significantly alter aggregate beliefs and expectations but reveals additional variation in how participants differentiate normative appropriateness across action subsets. Overall, the findings provide evidence of robustness to changes in elicitation timing and scope in environments with clear focal norms, while incentivization improves the accuracy of elicited normative expectations.
abstract_zh: 两步规范引出程序（意见匹配法）被广泛用于测量个人规范信念和激励性规范预期，然而关于其对常见设计变异的敏感性知之甚少。本研究通过考察当引出程序的要素发生变化时，个人规范信念、规范预期和行为是否随之改变，来检验该程序的稳健性。采用带有四点量表的在线独裁者博弈，基线处理要求参与者评估公平分配的适当性。两项处理分别操纵（i）引出时机（决策前与决策后）和（ii）规范预期的激励措施，而（iii）第三项处理通过要求参与者评估两个行动子集（公平分配和低份额分配）来改变范围。时机对行为、个人规范信念或规范预期没有显著影响，而对规范预期进行激励则提高了参与者正确识别众数个人规范信念的准确性。评估两个行动子集并未显著改变总体信念和预期，但揭示了参与者在不同行动子集间区分规范适当性方面的额外变异。总体而言，研究结果提供了在具有明确焦点规范的环境中，引出时机和范围变化下程序稳健性的证据，而激励措施则提高了所引出规范预期的准确性。

title: Activation Costs, Fair Value, and Real Exchange Rate Adjustment
title_zh: 激活成本、公允价值与实际汇率调整
title_primary: 激活成本、公允价值与实际汇率调整
title_secondary: Activation Costs, Fair Value, and Real Exchange Rate Adjustment
authors: Mark Taylor
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Models of real-exchange-rate adjustment are generally based on traded-goods arbitrage. We develop an integrated equilibrium model in which costly arbitrage operates through both goods and foreign-exchange markets. Goods arbitrage narrows traded-goods law-of-one-price gaps by changing the bilateral traded-goods price differential and hence the nominal fair-value benchmark. Financial convergence traders compare the quoted nominal rate with this common but uncertain benchmark, and progressively more capital is mobilised as the absolute fair-value gap grows. Because the real exchange rate’s deviation from its productivity-conditioned centre is identically the nominal fair-value gap, both channels act on the same state. Heterogeneous activation costs convert discrete individual decisions into smooth aggregate correction. Under transparent benchmark restrictions, aggregation and market clearing deliver the exponential smooth-transition autoregressive (ESTAR) law as an exact equilibrium outcome and impose identifying and testable restrictions on its location, outer response and shape. We take the model to nine sterling bilateral rates spanning up to two and a quarter centuries and estimate the seven stationary cases jointly by exact maximum likelihood. Five pairs support a productivity-conditioned equilibrium; three adjust towards it nonlinearly and two are adequately approximated as linear. Transition-selection tests support even adjustment where both tails are informative, and pairwise and joint Weibull tests retain the exponent-two benchmark. Across the productivity-anchored pairs, allowing the equilibrium centre to move reduces the average floating-regime half-life of a 1% shock from sixteen to seven years, while 20% shocks have half-lives of one to four years. The results recast real-exchange-rate persistence as the combination of a moving equilibrium and state-dependent corrective capacity.
abstract_zh: 实际汇率调整模型通常基于贸易品套利。我们构建了一个整合的均衡模型，其中成本高昂的套利通过商品市场与外汇市场同时运作。商品套利通过改变双边贸易品价格差异，从而调整名义公允价值基准，缩小贸易品一价定律缺口。金融趋同交易者将报价的名义汇率与此共同但不确定的基准进行比较，随着绝对公允价值缺口的扩大，动员的资本逐渐增加。由于实际汇率偏离其生产率条件中心等同于名义公允价值缺口，两个渠道作用于同一状态变量。异质性激活成本将离散的个体决策转化为平滑的总量修正。在透明的基准限制下，加总与市场出清得出指数平滑转移自回归（ESTAR）法则作为精确的均衡结果，并对其位置、外部响应及形状施加可识别且可检验的限制。我们将该模型应用于九种英镑双边汇率，时间跨度长达两个半世纪，并通过精确最大似然法联合估计七个平稳情形。其中五对支持生产率条件均衡；三对向其非线性调整，两对可充分近似为线性。转移选择检验支持在两端尾部均具信息性时的对称调整，成对及联合Weibull检验保留了指数为二的基准。在生产率锚定的配对中，允许均衡中心移动使浮动汇率制度下1%冲击的平均半衰期从十六年降至七年，而20%冲击的半衰期为一至四年。结果将实际汇率持续性重新诠释为移动均衡与状态依赖修正能力的结合。

title: Measuring the Welfare Gains from Cardinal-Preference Mechanisms in School Choice
title_zh: 衡量学校选择中基数偏好机制的福利收益
title_primary: 衡量学校选择中基数偏好机制的福利收益
title_secondary: Measuring the Welfare Gains from Cardinal-Preference Mechanisms in School Choice
authors: Hülya Eraslan, Jeremy T. Fox, YingHua He
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Ordinal mechanisms use rankings but not preference intensities. Cardinal mechanisms also elicit school utilities, allowing them to use students’ preferences over assignment lotteries. We compare probabilistic serial with four cardinal mechanisms that maximize the same welfare objective under successively stronger restrictions: capacity-only, ε-envy-free, envy-free, and a welfare-maximizing cardinal-preference pseudomarket. Because the feasible sets are nested, maximum welfare weakly falls as the restrictions tighten from capacity alone to approximate no-envy, exact no-envy, and equal budgets with common prices. We establish positive and negative results on large-market truthtelling. All 44 theorem parts in the paper are machine-checked in the Lean 4 proof assistant. We develop methods for computing cardinal-preference pseudomarket equilibria for Seattle’s 898 students and 11 schools. Using set-identified cardinal preferences from Seattle high-school choice data, we estimate that, under exact capacity, capacity-only raises mean welfare over probabilistic serial by 0.053, equivalent to shifting 5.3 percentage points of assignment probability from the average student’s worst school to the top school. Exact envy-freeness retains 79% of this gain; best-found pseudomarket equilibria yield a mean gain of 0.002. The estimates show both the value of cardinal information and the welfare cost of pseudomarket fairness restrictions.
abstract_zh: 序数机制使用排名但不使用偏好强度。基数机制还引出学校效用，从而能够利用学生对分配抽签的偏好。我们将概率序列与四种基数机制进行比较，这些机制在依次增强的限制条件下最大化相同的福利目标：仅容量限制、ε-无嫉妒、无嫉妒，以及福利最大化的基数偏好伪市场。由于可行集是嵌套的，随着限制从仅容量到近似无嫉妒、精确无嫉妒以及具有共同价格的均等预算逐步收紧，最大福利呈弱下降趋势。我们在大市场诚实报告方面建立了正反两方面的结果。论文中所有44个定理部分均在Lean 4证明助手中进行了机器验证。我们开发了计算西雅图898名学生和11所学校基数偏好伪市场均衡的方法。利用西雅图高中选择数据中集合识别的基数偏好，我们估计，在精确容量下，仅容量限制相对于概率序列将平均福利提高了0.053，相当于将平均学生从最差学校到顶尖学校的分配概率转移了5.3个百分点。精确无嫉妒保留了这一增益的79%；最佳发现的伪市场均衡产生的平均增益为0.002。这些估计既显示了基数信息的价值，也揭示了伪市场公平限制的福利成本。

title: Labor Market Power with Worker and Firm Heterogeneity
title_zh: 具有工人与企业异质性的劳动力市场势力
title_primary: 具有工人与企业异质性的劳动力市场势力
title_secondary: Labor Market Power with Worker and Firm Heterogeneity
authors: David W. Berger, Kyle F. Herkenhoff, Jaehun Jeong, Simon Mongey
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How do firms set wages? How should governments set income taxes? If labor supply is inelastic to wages, firms can pay workers less than their marginal products, and governments can increase taxes without eroding the base. However, the structure of labor supply elasticities in the economy is complex. Recent empirics document variation across workers, firms, and margins (which firm to work at versus how many hours to work). To account for this rich structure of labor supply elasticities we extend the neoclassical model to include a discrete choice over which firm to work at, production complementarities and strategic interaction between heterogeneous, granular firms. In terms of wage setting, we find that novel effects of worker heterogeneity account for 78 percent of the variable component of labor supply elasticities and markdowns, and 89 percent of markdown differences between large and small firms. In terms of policy, higher progressivity makes labor supply less elastic, eroding the tax base by widening markdowns and worsening sorting. These channels (i) produce large declines in earnings following increases in marginal tax rates, consistent with empirical studies, and (ii) reduce optimal tax progressivity by one-third and associated welfare gains by two-thirds.
abstract_zh: 企业如何设定工资？政府应如何设定所得税？如果劳动力供给对工资缺乏弹性，企业可以支付低于其边际产出的工资，政府也可以在不侵蚀税基的情况下提高税收。然而，经济中劳动力供给弹性的结构十分复杂。近期实证研究记录了工人、企业以及不同边际（选择在哪家企业工作与选择工作多少小时）之间的差异。为解释劳动力供给弹性这一丰富结构，我们扩展了新古典模型，纳入对工作企业的离散选择、生产互补性以及异质性、颗粒型企业之间的战略互动。在工资设定方面，我们发现工人异质性的新效应解释了劳动力供给弹性和加价折价（markdowns）可变部分的78%，以及大企业与小企业之间加价折价差异的89%。在政策方面，更高的累进性使劳动力供给弹性降低，通过扩大加价折价和恶化匹配（sorting）侵蚀税基。这些渠道（i）导致边际税率提高后收入大幅下降，与实证研究一致；（ii）使最优税收累进性降低三分之一，相关福利收益减少三分之二。

title: Local charger availability and electric vehicle adoption: Evidence from Norway
title_zh: 本地充电桩可用性与电动汽车普及：来自挪威的证据
title_primary: 本地充电桩可用性与电动汽车普及：来自挪威的证据
title_secondary: Local charger availability and electric vehicle adoption: Evidence from Norway
authors: Costanza Cincotta, Øyvind Thomassen
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the effect of local public charging infrastructure on electric vehicle (EV) adoption using microdata from Norway between 2010 and 2023. We use million new car registrations, geocoded to buyers’ residences and matched to nearby charging stations, along with individual- and neighbourhood-level controls and fixed effects, to estimate the causal impact of local charger availability. We find statistically significant, but economically negligible effects: doubling charger density in 2023 increases the probability of EV adoption by less than 1 percentage point. Of the (74 percentage-point) increase in the EV share in new registrations from 2016 to 2023, less than one percentage point is explained by new publicly available chargers. Effects are heterogeneous, and largely driven by car buyers living in multi-dwelling housing, and those residing in large urban areas.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2010年至2023年间挪威的微观数据，考察了本地公共充电基础设施对电动汽车（EV）普及的影响。我们使用了百万条新车注册记录，这些记录按购买者居住地进行地理编码，并与附近的充电站相匹配，同时结合个人及社区层面的控制变量和固定效应，来估计本地充电设施可用性的因果效应。我们发现，虽然统计上显著，但经济效应微乎其微：到2023年，充电桩密度翻倍仅使电动汽车普及概率增加不到1个百分点。在2016年至2023年间新车注册中电动汽车份额（上升74个百分点）的增长中，不到1个百分点可归因于新增的公共充电设施。效应存在异质性，且主要由居住在多户住宅及大城市地区的购车者驱动。

title: Large-Load Electricity Customers and Spillovers on Household Prices: Evidence from U.S. Data Centers
title_zh: 大型电力用户与家庭电价溢出效应：来自美国数据中心的证据
title_primary: 大型电力用户与家庭电价溢出效应：来自美国数据中心的证据
title_secondary: Large-Load Electricity Customers and Spillovers on Household Prices: Evidence from U.S. Data Centers
authors: Valentina Bosetti, cameron Scalera, Filippo Pecci
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how large-load customers affect household electricity prices. We map the AI-associated data center build-out in the years following 2021 to U.S. utility territories and implement a shift-share design based on pre-AI fiber infrastructure. A standard deviation of ten data centers raises household electricity prices by 13%, and a single hyperscaler facility increases prices by 4%. Demand-driven channels seem to be the dominant mechanism, and households bear a disproportionate burden compared to other customers. Nonprofit utilities, energy surplus, and retail competition may mitigate price impacts. Our results provide novel insights about electricity price spillovers from large individual consumers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了大型负荷客户如何影响居民电价。我们将2021年后与人工智能相关的数据中心建设布局映射至美国公用事业区域，并基于人工智能前光纤基础设施实施了一种份额转移设计。每增加一个标准差的数据中心数量，居民电价上升13%，而单个超大规模设施则使电价提高4%。需求驱动渠道似乎是主导机制，且与其他客户相比，居民承担了不成比例的负担。非营利性公用事业、能源盈余及零售竞争可能缓解价格影响。我们的研究结果为大型个体消费者带来的电价溢出效应提供了新颖见解。

title: Foreign Exchange Regimes in (Normal Times and) Times of War: Insights from Ukraine
title_zh: （正常时期与）战争时期的外汇制度：来自乌克兰的启示
title_primary: （正常时期与）战争时期的外汇制度：来自乌克兰的启示
title_secondary: Foreign Exchange Regimes in (Normal Times and) Times of War: Insights from Ukraine
authors: de Groot, Oliver, Skok, Yevhenii
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: On February 24, 2022, as Russia invaded, the National Bank of Ukraine switched from a flexible to a fixed exchange rate regime. Was this policy response optimal? To answer this, we develop an open-economy model with both nominal rigidities and frictions in borrowing on international financial markets. We find that the carefully calibrated model can rationalize the NBU's decision: the optimal response to small shocks is to allow exchange rate flexibility, whereas in response to large shocks-such as an invasion-currency depreciation is suboptimal. For robustness, we consider tradable endowment, risk-premium, and non-tradable supply shocks, and add subsistence consumption.
abstract_zh: 2022年2月24日，随着俄罗斯入侵，乌克兰国家银行将汇率制度从浮动制转为固定制。这一政策应对是否最优？为回答此问题，我们构建了一个包含名义刚性和国际金融市场借款摩擦的开放经济模型。我们发现，经过仔细校准的模型能够合理解释乌克兰国家银行的决策：对小型冲击的最优应对是允许汇率浮动，而对大型冲击（如入侵）而言，货币贬值则非最优。为增强稳健性，我们考虑了可贸易禀赋冲击、风险溢价冲击和非贸易供给冲击，并引入了生存消费。

title: Paper Tiger? Chinese Science and Home Bias in Citations
title_zh: 纸老虎？中国科学与引文中的本土偏好

authors: Shumin Qiu, Claudia Steinwender, Pierre Azoulay, Stefano Carattini, Hanwei Huang 等

abstract: We investigate the phenomenon of home bias in scientific citations, where researchers disproportionately cite work from their own country. We develop a benchmark for expected citations based on the relative size of countries, defining home bias as deviations from this norm. Our findings reveal that China exhibits the largest home bias across all major countries and in nearly all scientific fields studied. This stands in contrast to the pattern of home bias for China's trade in goods and services, where China does not stand out from most industrialized countries. After adjusting citation counts for home bias, we demonstrate that China's apparent rise in citation rankings is overstated. Our adjusted ranking places China fourth globally, behind the US, the UK, and Germany, tempering the perception of China's scientific dominance.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了科学引文中存在的本土偏好现象，即研究人员倾向于过度引用本国研究成果。我们基于各国相对规模构建了一个预期引用基准，将偏离此基准的情况定义为本土偏好。研究发现，在所有主要国家及几乎所有研究的科学领域中，中国展现出最大的本土偏好。这一现象与中国在商品和服务贸易中的本土偏好模式形成对比，后者并未使中国在大多数工业化国家中显得突出。在调整引用次数以消除本土偏好影响后，我们证明中国在引用排名上的显著上升被高估了。调整后的排名将中国置于全球第四位，仅次于美国、英国和德国，从而缓和了对中国科学主导地位的认知。

abstract: Economists have long viewed monetary policy as influencing labour demand, with little effect on labour supply. This column discusses four studies that use different methods and data from the US, the UK, the euro area, and Australia, and independently find that monetary tightening induces households to adjust their labour supply. Adjustment margins include hours worked, labour market participation, job search, and household balance sheets. These findings illustrate that labour supply is a quantitatively meaningful channel of monetary transmission that has implications for the resilience of labour markets, the interaction of monetary and fiscal policy, and macroeconomic models of monetary transmission.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期以来将货币政策视为影响劳动力需求的因素，而对劳动力供给的影响甚微。本专栏讨论了四项研究，这些研究采用不同方法和来自美国、英国、欧元区及澳大利亚的数据，并独立发现货币紧缩促使家庭调整其劳动力供给。调整的边际包括工作时间、劳动力市场参与度、求职活动以及家庭资产负债表。这些发现表明，劳动力供给是货币传导中一个数量上重要的渠道，对劳动力市场的韧性、货币与财政政策的相互作用以及货币传导的宏观经济模型具有启示意义。

abstract: Banks lend more to banks that are similar to them. Using data from the German credit register and proprietary supervisory data on the quality of banks' loan portfolio, we show that a similar portfolio of the lending and borrowing bank helps to overcome information asymmetries in interbank markets. While interbank lenders generally do not adjust their lending to information on the counterparty's portfolio quality, banks with an exposure to similar industries and regions strongly react to this private information. Lending between similar banks is particularly important for borrowers with opaque loan portfolios, which do not obtain credit from dissimilar peers.
abstract_zh: 银行更倾向于向与自己相似的银行提供贷款。利用德国信贷登记数据以及关于银行贷款组合质量的专有监管数据，我们证明，贷款银行与借款银行相似的贷款组合有助于克服银行间市场中的信息不对称问题。尽管银行间贷款人通常不会根据对手方贷款组合质量的信息调整其贷款行为，但那些在相似行业和地区有风险敞口的银行会强烈响应这一私有信息。相似银行之间的贷款对于贷款组合不透明的借款人尤为重要，这些借款人无法从异质同行处获得信贷。

title: A two-pronged approach to currency internationalization

authors: Qing Liu, Wenlan Luo, Jiatong Niu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Policies aimed at promoting currency internationalization often target frictions in both capital and current account transactions. We study this two-pronged approach using a dynamic general equilibrium model in which an international currency serves as both a store of value and a medium of exchange. Due to the complementarity between different functions of an international currency, a two-pronged approach is more effective than policies with a single focus. We analytically characterize this policy complementarity and apply the model to China’s renminbi internationalization reforms during 2010-2021. We find that: (1) These reforms reduced the return wedge on foreign held renminbi bonds by 4.1 percentage points (p.p.) and lowered the cost of renminbi-settled international trade by 0.9 p.p. in trade-revenue equivalent. (2) Policy complementarity accounted for half of the overall policy effect. (3) A single-focused policy — targeting only capital (current) account frictions — would have raised fiscal costs by a factor of 2.1 (1.8).
abstract_zh: 旨在促进货币国际化的政策往往针对资本与经常账户交易中的摩擦。我们通过一个动态一般均衡模型来研究这种双管齐下的策略，在该模型中，国际货币既充当价值储存手段，又充当交换媒介。鉴于国际货币不同功能之间的互补性，双管齐下的方法比单一聚焦的政策更为有效。我们从理论上刻画了这种政策互补性，并将模型应用于2010-2021年间中国人民币国际化的改革实践。研究发现：（1）这些改革使境外持有的人民币债券的回报率差距缩小了4.1个百分点，并以贸易收入等价计算，将人民币结算的国际贸易成本降低了0.9个百分点。（2）政策互补性贡献了总体政策效果的一半。（3）若仅针对资本（或经常）账户摩擦采取单一聚焦政策，财政成本将分别增加至原来的2.1倍（或1.8倍）。

authors: Charles Bean

abstract: In the first part of the paper we outline a method for estimating a class of models in which news or surprises appear and expectations are formed rationally. The method is an extension of the errors-in-variables method of McCallum and Wickens. As a by-product some of Pagan's results on the circumstances under which the commonly use two-step method of estimating surprise models is efficient are shown to be a consequence of well-known theorems on the efficiency of sub-system estimation when a subset of equations is exactly identified. In the second part of the paper the method is applied to Hall's random-walk model of consumption, which is extended to allow for stochastic interest rates and for leisure and government spending to be substitutes for private spending. The extended formulation is a great deal more successful at capturing the salient features of the data. We also derive approximate restrictions across the parameters of the model due to the rational expectations hypothesis but find that they are marginally rejected by the data. Finally, we evaluate the ability of the life-cycle with rational expectations model to encompass alternative models.
abstract_zh: 本文第一部分概述了一种估计包含新闻或意外冲击且预期理性形成的模型类别的方法。该方法是对McCallum与Wickens变量误差法的扩展。作为副产品，本文证明了Pagan关于常用两步法估计意外模型有效性的部分结论，实为子方程组恰好识别时子系统估计效率经典定理的推论。第二部分将该方法应用于Hall的消费随机游走模型，通过引入随机利率、休闲与政府支出对私人支出的替代效应进行扩展。扩展后的模型在捕捉数据关键特征方面显著提升。我们进一步推导了理性预期假设下模型参数的近似约束条件，但发现这些约束被数据轻微拒绝。最后，本文评估了理性预期生命周期模型对其他竞争性模型的涵盖能力。

abstract: Using a unique matched bank-employer-employee administrative dataset for Italy, we construct an exogenous firm-level measure of exposure to the credit shock during the Global Financial Crisis, based on pre-crisis firm-bank relationships. We track outcomes for firms and workers up to 11 years after the shock. More exposed firms experience persistently lower growth in bank credit, which in turn leads to weaker investment and employment dynamics due to capital-labor complementarity. More capital-intensive firms and their workers suffer the most. Displaced workers reallocate primarily to less capital-intensive firms, incurring persistent losses in labor earnings.
abstract_zh: 利用意大利独特的银行-雇主-雇员匹配行政数据集，我们基于危机前的企业-银行关系，构建了全球金融危机期间企业层面信贷冲击暴露度的外生衡量指标。我们追踪了冲击发生后长达11年的企业与工人结果。信贷暴露度更高的企业持续面临更低的银行信贷增长，进而因资本-劳动互补性导致投资与就业动态疲弱。资本密集度更高的企业及其工人遭受的损失最为严重。被解雇的工人主要重新配置到资本密集度较低的企业，并承受持久的劳动收入损失。

abstract: This paper measures concentration in narrowly defined product markets for a broad range of consumer goods and services in the United States from 1994 to 2019. We document two main empirical facts. First, concentration levels are high. Of the markets in our sample, 44.4 percent are “highly concentrated” as defined by US regulators. Second, market concentration has been decreasing since 1994. The median HHI falls from 2,362 to 2,045. These findings stand in stark contrast to the prior literature, which uses market definitions that are aggregated to a level that is typically too broad to accurately reflect competition in consumer markets. official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Extreme weather events generate systematic forecast errors in credit risk models. Using proprietary loan-level data covering approximately 250,000 corporate loans over 2012–2023, we find that exposure to extreme weather significantly predicts realized default rates after conditioning on model-implied probabilities. Effects are stronger for early-year exposures and reflect persistent regional vulnerability rather than transitory fluctuations. These results suggest that omitted climate risk factors contribute to systematic model miscalibration, robust across specifications. More broadly, when relevant weather events are excluded, forecast errors may become systematic rather than idiosyncratic, with implications for model design and the efficient allocation of credit.
abstract_zh: 极端天气事件会导致信用风险模型产生系统性预测误差。基于2012至2023年间约25万笔企业贷款的专有贷款级数据，本研究发现，在控制模型隐含概率后，极端天气暴露度能显著预测实际违约率。该效应在年初暴露中更为显著，且反映的是持续的区域脆弱性而非暂时性波动。这些结果表明，遗漏的气候风险因素会导致模型系统性校准偏差，且该结论在多种设定下保持稳健。更广泛而言，当相关天气事件被排除时，预测误差可能从特质性转为系统性，这对模型设计及信贷资源的有效配置具有重要启示。

title: Haircut, interest rate, and collateral quality in the tri-party repo market: Evidence and theory

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using transaction-level data from the Korean tri-party repo market, we study how repo contract terms interact with collateral quality. Both haircuts and interest rates rise with collateral risk, consistent with existing evidence. Conditional on collateral quality, however, we find a trade-off: a one-percentage-point increase in the spread is associated with a 1.3-percentage-point reduction in the haircut. The same increase in the interest rate is associated with a smaller reduction in the haircut under heightened market uncertainty, indicating that insurance against default becomes more valuable as default risk rises. We show that the interaction between lenders’ incentives to acquire information and borrowers’ opportunistic default risk explains both the positive unconditional relationship and the negative conditional relationship between haircuts and interest rates.
abstract_zh: 利用韩国三方回购市场的交易数据，我们研究了回购合约条款如何与抵押品质量相互作用。保证金率和利率均随抵押品风险上升而上升，这与现有证据一致。然而，在控制抵押品质量后，我们发现一种权衡关系：利差每增加一个百分点，保证金率降低1.3个百分点。在市场不确定性加剧的情况下，利率的同等上升会导致保证金率降幅更小，这表明随着违约风险上升，针对违约的保险价值增加。我们证明，贷款人获取信息的动机与借款人机会主义违约风险之间的相互作用，解释了保证金率与利率之间正向的无条件关系以及负向的条件关系。

title: Ports, Technology and Inter-City Trade: The Economics and Geopolitics of Evolving Maritime Transport Networks

title_secondary: Ports, Technology and Inter-City Trade: The Economics and Geopolitics of Evolving Maritime Transport Networks
authors: Dávid Krisztián Nagy, Réka Juhász, Claudia Steinwender, Woan Foong Wong
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data—digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information—we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network—and of who controls them.
abstract_zh: 海上运输仍是全球贸易的支柱，但承载这一运输体系的港口与航运网络已因集装箱化及相关技术进步而发生深刻变革。基于新获取的颗粒化数据——数字化历史航运记录、地理参照船舶轨迹及单次货运路径信息——我们归纳出关于海运网络结构与演进的五个典型事实：全球航运活动高度集中于排名动态变化的头部港口，而低排名港口则呈现分散化趋势；同时，中国国有港口码头运营商在全球吞吐量中的占比持续攀升，在提升整体港口运营效率的同时，其效率增益主要惠及中国籍船舶。我们以这些事实为框架，系统梳理了快速发展的相关文献：集装箱化重塑了港口城市的扩张空间，强化了枢纽-辐射式集中格局（虽带来巨大但局部化的福利增益），将港口嵌入多式联运网络（放大基础设施投资回报），并催生了市场势力、拥堵与环境成本问题。这些证据共同表明，不断演进的海运技术在深化全球一体化的同时，也加剧了运输网络关键节点及其控制者的经济与地缘政治重要性。

title: Pricing and Production Without the Invisible Hand
title_zh: 无形之手缺失下的定价与生产
title_primary: 无形之手缺失下的定价与生产
title_secondary: Pricing and Production Without the Invisible Hand
authors: Joel P. Flynn, George Nikolakoudis, Karthik Sastry
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Modern theories of the business cycle do not allow for the simultaneous rational choice of both prices and quantities, instead assuming that an “invisible hand” determines one of these variables to clear markets. In this paper, we develop a macroeconomic model in which both prices and quantities are chosen optimally by firms and exchange is both voluntary and efficient. As a consequence, individual markets will generically be in Walrasian disequilibrium: either slack (over-supplied) or rationed (under-supplied). The absence of market clearing changes pricing and production in qualitatively important ways: markups are governed by the probability of rationing rather than the elasticity of demand, and higher uncertainty reduces production and increases markups. Marrying the Old and New Keynesian traditions, we study general Walrasian disequilibrium with rational expectations and optimal firm decisions. On a technical level, we characterize cross-market spillovers arising from rationed demand with differentiated goods, overcoming the standard combinatorial problem that arises when studying multi-market disequilibrium. Unlike in New Keynesian economies, monetary shocks propagate by reducing product-market slack, raising aggregate labor productivity and consumption with muted effects on employment, while uncertainty shocks act as stagflationary cost-push shocks.
abstract_zh: 现代商业周期理论不允许同时理性选择价格和数量，而是假设“看不见的手”决定其中一个变量以出清市场。本文构建了一个宏观经济模型，其中价格和数量均由企业最优选择，且交换既是自愿的也是有效的。因此，单个市场通常处于瓦尔拉斯非均衡状态：要么松弛（供给过剩），要么配给（供给不足）。市场非出清在本质上改变了定价与生产行为：加成率由配给概率而非需求弹性决定，更高的不确定性会减少产量并提高加成率。融合新旧凯恩斯主义传统，我们研究了具有理性预期和企业最优决策的一般瓦尔拉斯非均衡。在技术层面，我们刻画了差异化商品因配给需求产生的跨市场溢出效应，克服了研究多市场非均衡时面临的标准组合问题。与新凯恩斯主义经济不同，货币冲击通过减少产品市场松弛来传导，从而提高总劳动生产率和消费，但对就业影响有限；而不确定性冲击则表现为滞胀型成本推动冲击。

abstract: As the concept of soil health gains prominence, it becomes increasingly important to examine how states design and implement soil health policies. Does soil health offer a novel pathway to enact and legitimize institutional changes toward more sustainable farming systems, or does it risk becoming another neologism that preserves status quo, productivist agriculture? abstract_zh: 随着土壤健康概念的日益凸显，审视各州如何设计与实施土壤健康政策变得愈发重要。土壤健康是否为朝向更可持续农业系统的制度变革提供了一条新颖路径，抑或它有可能沦为又一个维护现状、维持生产主义农业的新术语？我们通过分析印度最雄心勃勃的以土壤健康为核心的国家主导计划之一——土壤健康卡（SHC）计划，来探讨这些问题。该计划旨在为全国每位农民提供每两年一次的土壤检测报告，其前提假设是，改善信息将鼓励更明智地使用化肥和农药。这一假设反映了农业科学界对量化土壤健康重要性的广泛强调。基于政府文件和农民感知研究（样本数=38），我们发现，尽管农民对这些卡片持积极态度，但他们在耕作实践中几乎没有做出实质性改变。作为典型案例，印度宏大的土壤健康卡计划表明，仅靠量化并不足够，甚至可能削弱对变革性政策改革的推动力。有效且持久的变革在于将量化土壤健康的努力与（a）多元知识论方法相结合，以促进知识生产与传播。

abstract: ABSTRACT Linking payments from agri‐environment schemes to ecological results or to collective outcomes is viewed as a promising way to increase the effectiveness of agri‐environmental conservation. However, the two approaches are rarely combined. In this study, we test the performance of result‐based payments with collective contracts in a contextualised economic experiment with 540 non‐agricultural and agricultural students in Germany. Combining result‐based payments with collective contracts may hold potential by allowing farmers to share the risks associated with result‐based payments within a group. A downside of collective contracts, however, is the creation of a social dilemma, as individual payments depend on group outcomes. We find no evidence of differences in conservation levels under result‐based payments with collective as compared to individual contracts, suggesting that risk‐sharing benefits and effects of the social dilemma offset each other. We further examine the performance of collective contracts for varying risk levels that could, for example, reflect different geological and climatic conditions across Europe. Result‐based payments with collective contracts motivate higher conservation efforts in our experiment when external risks are high. Further, high risks appear to foster group cooperation under collective contracts, potentially leading to more equitable and predictable outcomes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 将农业环境计划的支付与生态结果或集体成果挂钩，被视为提升农业环境保护有效性的有前景途径。然而，这两种方法很少被结合使用。在本研究中，我们通过一项情境化经济实验，对德国540名非农业和农业学生进行了基于结果的支付与集体合同的绩效测试。将基于结果的支付与集体合同结合，可能通过允许农民在群体内分担与基于结果的支付相关的风险而具有潜力。然而，集体合同的一个缺点是产生了社会困境，因为个体支付依赖于群体成果。我们发现，在基于结果的支付下，集体合同与个体合同在保护水平上没有差异，这表明风险分担的好处与社会困境的影响相互抵消。我们进一步考察了不同风险水平下集体合同的表现，这些风险水平可能反映欧洲各地不同的地质和气候条件。在我们的实验中，当外部风险较高时，基于结果的支付与集体合同能激励更高的保护努力。此外，高风险似乎促进了集体合同下的群体合作，可能导致更公平和可预测的结果。

title: Contract enforcement in a stateless economy

title_primary: 无国家经济中的合同执行
title_secondary: Contract enforcement in a stateless economy
authors: Sultan Mehmood, Georgii Marinichev, Sajwaar Khalid, Daniel Chen, Margarita Kudaeva
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How are contracts enforced when the state cannot compel compliance? We study contract enforcement in a large illegal gambling market where legal recourse is unavailable and participation is largely anonymous. We observe more than 70 percent of gamblers repay their debts, indicating substantial baseline enforcement even in the absence of formal courts. We interpret this descriptive pattern as consistent with a broader set of informal enforcement forces, including repeated interaction, credit constraints, and reputational considerations. We then provide experimental evidence on one specific channel by experimentally varying reputational stakes and the time available to repay. Increasing reputational sanctions and extending the payment deadline raises repayment by a modest but significant amount, from roughly 70 percent to about 77 percent. These effects imply that reputational incentives can strengthen cooperation to a meaningful degree. Overall, our evidence suggests that impersonal markets can sustain substantial repayment without state enforcement, and that reputational sanctions further increase compliance.
abstract_zh: 当国家无法强制履约时，合同如何得到执行？我们研究了一个大型非法赌博市场中的合同执行情况，在该市场中，法律救济途径不可用，且参与者大多匿名。我们观察到超过70%的赌徒偿还了债务，这表明即使在缺乏正式法院的情况下，也存在显著的基线执行机制。我们将这一描述性模式解释为与更广泛的非正式执行力量相一致，包括重复互动、信贷约束和声誉考量。随后，我们通过实验性地改变声誉风险和还款时间，针对一个具体渠道提供了实验证据。增加声誉制裁并延长还款期限，使还款率从大约70%适度但显著地提升至约77%。这些效应表明，声誉激励能够在有意义的程度上强化合作。总体而言，我们的证据表明，非人格化市场在没有国家执行的情况下也能维持可观的还款率，而声誉制裁进一步提高了合规性。

official: 官方在线 2026-03-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper uses a large individual‐record‐level dataset on sick leave to examine adult morbidity in the United Kingdom between 1850 and 1908. From 1859 onwards postal workers were eligible to receive a pension or gratuity when they retired or were forced to stop working due to ill health. Their pension application forms contain information on up to 10 years of sick leave taken prior to retirement by each retiree. These data have several advantages over previous sources of information on morbidity in this period. Sick leave was closely monitored by the Post Office's medical service, mitigating issues around the inflation of morbidity raised in the context of friendly society data; they cover the entirety of the United Kingdom; they include workers from the service sector as well as manufacturing occupations; and they include a greater proportion and number of women than previous sources. The paper discusses the nature of these data and the administrative systems that created them before examining the trends and modelling the determinants of sick leave. It concludes that postal workers became increasingly likely to take time off during this period but that the duration of sick leave remained stable. These changes were driven by changes to sick leave regulations; shifts in the composition of the workforce by age, occupation, gender, and location; and changes in the intensity of postal work.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一份涵盖1850至1908年间英国病假记录的大型个体层面数据集，考察了该时期的成人发病率。自1859年起，邮政工作人员在退休或因健康原因被迫停止工作时，有资格领取养老金或一次性补助金。他们的养老金申请表格中包含了每位退休人员在退休前长达10年的病假记录。与这一时期其他发病率信息来源相比，这些数据具有多项优势。邮政部门的医疗服务机构对病假进行了严格监控，从而缓解了友好社会数据中关于发病率虚增的问题；这些数据覆盖了整个英国；不仅包括制造业职业，还涵盖了服务业工作者；并且相较于以往来源，包含了更多数量和比例的女性。本文首先探讨了这些数据的性质及其产生的行政体系，随后分析了病假趋势并构建了其决定因素的模型。研究得出结论，在此期间，邮政工作人员请假的可能性逐渐增加，但病假持续时间保持稳定。这些变化受到病假规定调整、劳动力在年龄、职业、性别和地域构成上的变化，以及邮政工作强度变化等因素的驱动。

title: Sex, Lies and Birth Statistics: The Mysterious Case of the Spanish Missing Women

authors: Manuel Bagues, Carmen Villa
official: 官方在线 2026-02-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Official Spanish birth registry data report sex ratios well above expected levels between 1975 and 2000, peaking at 109 boys per 100 girls in the early 1980s, the highest in the world at that time. Prior research has attributed these elevated ratios to factors such as maternal age, birth order, and differential prenatal care. We show that they instead reflect systematic coding errors by the Spanish Statistical Office. Census data reveal normal sex ratios for the same cohorts. The birth registry also exhibits implausible monthly volatility and asymmetrically distributed outliers, consistent with one-directional miscoding of females as males. Additional corroborating evidence comes from provisional birth statistics, which show significantly lower sex ratios than the finalised records, and from anomalous patterns in adjacent fields on the birth registration form. Our findings underscore the responsibility of statistical agencies to validate administrative records and cross-check them against alternative sources.
abstract_zh: 西班牙官方出生登记数据显示，1975年至2000年间性别比显著高于预期水平，1980年代初达到峰值——每100名女婴对应109名男婴，为当时全球最高。此前研究将这一异常性别比归因于母亲年龄、出生顺序及差异化产前护理等因素。我们证明，这实际上反映了西班牙国家统计局的系统性编码错误。人口普查数据显示，同一出生队列的性别比正常。出生登记数据还呈现出不合常理的月度波动及非对称分布的异常值，这与将女性单向误编码为男性的模式相符。临时出生统计数据显示的性别比显著低于最终记录，且出生登记表相邻字段存在异常模式，这些均为佐证。我们的研究凸显了统计机构验证行政记录并与其他数据源交叉核验的责任。

title: Micro and Macro Cost-Price Dynamics in Normal Times and during Inflation Surges

abstract: We develop a unified approach to studying cost-price dynamics in the cross-section of firms in order to explain the time series of aggregate inflation, both during normal times and inflation surges. A key novelty is the use of microdata on firms’ prices and production costs to construct an empirical measure of price gaps — the deviation between a firm’s listed and optimal price. We characterize the mapping between price gaps and the size and frequency of price adjustments and take them to the data to test nonparametrically how firms’ pricing strategies align with the predictions of different pricing models, conditional on shocks of different magnitudes. The microdata provide strong evidence of state dependence: the passthrough of costs into inflation increases more than proportionately when the economy is hit by large aggregate shocks. In contrast, in normal times, the frequency of price adjustment is approximately constant, and the microdata conform to the predictions of time-dependent models (e.g., Calvo 1983). Conditional on the path of aggregate cost shocks extracted from the data, a generalized state-dependent pricing model accounts well for both the low and stable inflation of the pre-pandemic period and the nonlinear surge that followed.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种统一的分析框架，研究企业截面中的成本-价格动态，以解释总体通胀的时间序列特征，既涵盖正常时期也涵盖通胀激增时期。一个关键创新在于利用企业价格与生产成本的微观数据，构建价格缺口（即企业标价与最优价格之间的偏离）的实证度量指标。我们刻画了价格缺口与价格调整幅度及频率之间的映射关系，并将其应用于数据中，以非参数方式检验企业在不同冲击强度下定价策略与各类定价模型预测的一致性。微观数据为状态依赖性提供了有力证据：当经济遭受大规模总体冲击时，成本向通胀的传导效应会以超比例方式增强。相比之下，在正常时期，价格调整频率大致保持恒定，微观数据符合时间依赖模型（如Calvo 1983）的预测。基于从数据中提取的总体成本冲击路径，一个广义的状态依赖定价模型能够很好地解释疫情前通胀的低位稳定特征以及随后出现的非线性激增现象。

abstract: We introduce a novel simulation-based method for signal extraction in a general class of state space models. It can be used to estimate time-varying conditional means, modes, and quantiles, and to predict latent variables or forecast observations. The method consists of generating artificial datasets from the model and estimating the quantities of interest via extremum estimation. The approach is broadly applicable and its implementation is straightforward. The method is suited for signal extraction in cases of long time series, missing data, or high-dimensionality. Furthermore, we demonstrate its use in real-time filtering, where most of the computations can be performed in advance, and in fixed-interval smoothing. Conditions for the stability and convergence of the filtering method are discussed, and its key properties are illustrated by various applications, including nonlinear and high-dimensional models.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的基于模拟的信号提取方法，适用于一般类别的状态空间模型。该方法可用于估计时变条件均值、众数和分位数，并预测潜在变量或预报观测值。其过程包括从模型中生成人工数据集，并通过极值估计来估算感兴趣的量。此方法适用范围广泛，实现简便，特别适合处理长时间序列、数据缺失或高维情况下的信号提取。此外，我们展示了其在实时滤波中的应用，其中大部分计算可预先完成，以及固定区间平滑中的应用。文中讨论了滤波方法稳定性与收敛性的条件，并通过包括非线性及高维模型在内的多种应用，阐明了其关键特性。

abstract: In density forecasts, respondents are asked to assign probabilities to a response scale with pre‐specified ranges of inflation. In two large‐scale experiments, one conducted in the US and one in Germany, we show how the specifics of the response scale determine the results: Shifting, compressing, or expanding the scale leads to shifted, compressed, and expanded forecasts. Quantifying this effect using the scale most widely used among central banks, we find that mean forecast, uncertainty, and disagreement can vary by several percentage points. Density forecasts may severely misestimate the “true” inflation expectations, and may generate spurious changes in reported inflation uncertainty. The analysis suggests several ways to reduce this bias.
abstract_zh: 在密度预测中，受访者需对预设通胀区间的响应量表分配概率。通过在美国和德国开展的两项大规模实验，我们揭示了响应量表的具体设计如何决定预测结果：移动、压缩或扩展量表会导致预测值相应偏移、压缩或扩展。采用央行最广泛使用的量表量化这一效应后，我们发现平均预测值、不确定性和分歧程度可能相差数个百分点。密度预测可能严重误估"真实"通胀预期，并导致报告的通胀不确定性出现虚假变化。分析表明，可通过多种方式减少此类偏差。

abstract: This study examines how China’s mandatory corporate social responsibility (CSR) disclosure regulation influences firms’ international business strategies. Using a difference-in-differences design, the analysis reveals heterogeneous effects across international activities. On the trade side, mandatory CSR disclosure enhances firms’ export competitiveness by promoting product quality upgrading through improved information transparency. This positive effect is particularly pronounced in markets with stronger CSR concerns, under more intense export competition, and when information asymmetry with foreign buyers is higher. By contrast, no significant change is observed in foreign trademark applications, suggesting that disclosure fosters substantive quality improvements rather than symbolic brand building. On the investment side, mandatory disclosure reduces firms’ overseas expansion The adverse effect is stronger when firms face greater compliance pressure, external monitoring and financing constraints. Overall, the findings highlight the dual role of mandatory CSR disclosure: while it stimulates export-oriented upgrading, it simultaneously discourages international investment, thereby reshaping the allocation of firms’ global business strategies.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中国强制性企业社会责任（CSR）披露规定如何影响企业的国际商业策略。通过采用双重差分设计，分析揭示了不同国际活动中的异质性效应。在贸易方面，强制性CSR披露通过提升信息透明度促进产品质量升级，进而增强企业的出口竞争力。这一积极效应在CSR关注度更高的市场、出口竞争更为激烈以及与外国买家信息不对称程度更高的情况下尤为显著。相反，外国商标申请未见显著变化，表明披露促进了实质性的质量改进而非象征性的品牌建设。在投资方面，强制性披露减少了企业的海外扩张，当企业面临更大的合规压力、外部监督和融资约束时，这一不利影响更为明显。总体而言，研究结果凸显了强制性CSR披露的双重作用：一方面刺激出口导向的升级，另一方面同时抑制国际投资，从而重塑企业全球业务策略的配置。
